count.heading: The family of Virgil Pokorny and Pat Hulse
count.note: The book lists two children under this heading, but labels them "Children of Pat Hulse:" (Laurie, b. 1967, and Mike, b. 1969, born before Virgil and Pat married in 1983). They are modelled in a one-parent family of Pat Hulse (pat-hulse-children), not as Virgil's children, so virgil1944-pat has 0 children and pat-hulse-children has the printed 2.

count.heading: The family of Curtis Delbert Mares and Delores Johnson
count.note: The book lists six children under this heading, after "He married Delores Johnson. Divorced. Married (2) Delores Englebrecht. Their children:". The children's own entries (Janet Kay, Vicki Lynn and Patricia Ann on s040; Susan Marie and Delbert Donald on s041) each name their parents as Curtis Mares and Delores Englebrecht, so all six are modelled in the second-marriage family curtis1927-delores-englebrecht (6 children); the heading's family, curtis1927-delores-johnson, has 0.
